text.title: Elder Juggernaut
text.body: High above the pine line, the primeval Elder Juggernaut—awakened not by malice, but as the dying continent's own bedrock thrashing in tectonic agony—shakes the highland cairn beside twin granite wardens. Huntsman Kael warns ordinary steel shatters against its hide.
text.obj.0: Hunt and silence the Elder Juggernaut
text.msg.1: It is no servant of the Caldera—it is the ancient bedrock itself roaring in tectonic pain as the continent tears apart. Keep earth-breaking spells and heavy bolts ready; ordinary steel shatters against its hide!
text.msg.2: Its stomps split the ridge with jagged fissures as runic retainers surge down from the highland cairn!
text.msg.3: Its glowing core shatters, returning the tragic titan to silent stone and exposing one thousand ancient runic coins embedded in its chest!
text.win: The Elder Juggernaut rests in silent stone and the seismic threat above Harborwatch is stilled.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell upon the highland cairn of the Elder Juggernaut.
